# Aigency Monorepo — Full Context

## Project

Aigency — multi-agent AI operating system. Turborepo monorepo with pnpm workspaces.

## Repository Facts

- Location: `/Users/antonioreid/CODE/00_PROJECTS/00_APPS/aigency-monorepo`
- Package Manager: pnpm 9.15.4
- Node.js: >= 20
- TypeScript: 5.7 (strict mode)
- Build: Turborepo 2.9.7
- No git remote — local-only repository
- Default branch: main

## Workspace Layout

```
aigency-monorepo/
├── apps/
│   ├── contracts/     — Solidity smart contracts (Foundry, Base L2)
│   ├── librarian/     — Knowledge graph curator service
│   ├── membrane/      — 3D spatial interface (Three.js + React)
│   ├── oracle/        — SurrealDB memory service
│   ├── router/        — LLM routing proxy (port 8402)
│   └── telos/         — Deep Context Framework
├── packages/
│   ├── agent-core/    — Agent registry, types, AgentCallsign enum
│   ├── design-tokens/ — W3C DTCG design tokens
│   ├── honcho/        — Honcho peer/identity client
│   ├── mem-brain/     — Unified memory layer
│   ├── surreal/       — SurrealDB client, LIVE queries
│   ├── tsconfig/      — Shared TypeScript configs
│   └── vault-tools/   — Lint, compile, flush utilities
├── agents/
│   ├── atlas/         — Revenue & Sales Ops
│   ├── cipher/        — Engineering & DevOps
│   ├── compass/       — Finance & Operations
│   ├── echo/          — Marketing & Content
│   ├── herald/        — Communications
│   ├── iris/          — Design & Brand Systems
│   ├── vector/        — Strategy & Intelligence
│   └── zenith/        — Chief of Staff & Orchestrator
├── wiki/              — Comprehensive documentation
├── CLAUDE.md          — Working memory for Claude
└── package.json       — Root monorepo config
```

## Apps

### Router (@aigency/router)
- OpenAI-compatible HTTP proxy on port 8402
- 14-dimension request classification (token count, code presence, reasoning keywords, math, multi-turn, question complexity, technical domain, creative task)
- Quota-preservation routing strategy
- RateLimitTracker with configurable cooldown
- Fallback chain of up to 3 models
- Configuration via YAML + environment variables
- Zod schema validation

### Membrane (@aigency/membrane)
- Three.js + @react-three/fiber 3D canvas
- Floating frosted glass UI panels
- Design tokens from @aigency/design-tokens
- Planned: SynapTree knowledge graph, QuerySurface, DirectiveFeed, TimelineRail

### Oracle (@aigency/oracle)
- Bootstraps SurrealDB with 11 agent records
- Subscribes to lint_run timeline events
- Honcho workspace initialization
- Intended off-chain submitter for HarvestMoon.sol metrics

### Librarian (@aigency/librarian)
- Scheduled lint/compile/flush workflow
- Lint computes health score (0-100), wiki density (0.0-1.0), vault age
- Compile transforms raw session notes to wiki articles via LLM
- Flush syncs session logs to SurrealDB timeline (placeholder)
- Emits lint_run timeline event when harvest conditions met

### Contracts (@aigency/contracts)
- Foundry-based Solidity development
- Base L2 (chain ID 8453) / Base Sepolia (84532)
- HarvestMoon.sol: quality-gated graft minting
- Thresholds: health >= 85, density >= 0.70, age >= 90 days, 30-day cooldown

### TELOS (@aigency/telos)
- Deep Context Framework for agent identity
- Telos Context Files (TCFs): markdown documents with Mission, Problems, Goals, KPIs, Strategies, Risks, Narrative, Projects, Activity Log
- 10-phase interview protocol
- Future: CLI tool, web UI, auto-deployment, agent substrate integration

## Packages

### Agent Core (@aigency/agent-core)
- AgentCallsign union type (11 literals)
- AgentIdentity interface
- AGENT_REGISTRY constant
- AgentRoutingContext interface
- TaskComplexity union: SIMPLE | MEDIUM | COMPLEX | REASONING
- MemoryBlockType union
- AigencyEvent interface

### Surreal (@aigency/surreal)
- SurrealClient singleton (WebSocket connection manager)
- LIVE query helpers (subscribe, onEvent, onAgentStatus)
- Record types: AgentRecord, DirectiveRecord, PatternRecord, TimelineRecord
- Graph edge types: DecidedByEdge, InformedByEdge, SupersedesEdge

### Honcho (@aigency/honcho)
- HonchoClient wrapper around honcho-ai SDK
- getPeer, startSession, addMessage, dream methods
- AigencyPeer and AigencySession types
- Note: honcho-ai@0.2.0 is deprecated on npm

### Mem-Brain (@aigency/mem-brain)
- MemBrain unified memory interface
- Combines SurrealDB (directives, patterns, timeline, LIVE) and Honcho (sessions, messages, dreaming)
- Vector similarity search with 0.75 cosine threshold

### Design Tokens (@aigency/design-tokens)
- W3C DTCG token exports (atoms, molecules, organisms)
- agentColor(callsign), nodeShape(type), opacityForAge(hours) accessors
- Token JSON at src/synapttree-design-tokens.json

### Vault Tools (@aigency/vault-tools)
- lint: health score, wiki density, vault age, harvest readiness
- compile: LLM-powered raw-to-wiki transformation
- flush: session log sync to SurrealDB (placeholder)
- Binaries: vault-lint, vault-compile, vault-flush

## Tech Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| DB | SurrealDB 3.0 | Multi-model: graph + vector + document + LIVE |
| Peer identity | Honcho ^0.2.0 | Cross-session reasoning, dreaming |
| LLM inference | MLX + Llama.cpp | Local-first, no Ollama |
| LLM router | apps/router | OpenAI-compat proxy, quota-aware |
| Chain | Base L2 (8453) | EVM, low gas, Coinbase |
| Contracts | Foundry | forge + cast + anvil |
| Frontend | React + Three.js + @react-three/fiber | SynapTree 3D graph |
| Package manager | pnpm workspaces | Fast, disk-efficient |
| Build system | Turborepo | Task pipelines with caching |

## Critical Rules

- ZENITH and NEXUS are identical twins. ZENITH runs Core Exec Squad; NEXUS runs Agile Squad. NEXUS is NOT in this repo.
- All 10 exec agents + THE_ARCHITECT are in AGENT_REGISTRY.
- agent.yaml files point to aigency-vault/ for SOUL.md and RULES.md — they do not duplicate them.
- API keys are never in config files; use PROVIDER_*_API_KEY environment variables.

## Commands

```bash
pnpm install          # install all workspace deps
pnpm dev              # start all apps in dev mode (turbo)
pnpm build            # build all packages + apps
pnpm test             # run all tests
pnpm router           # dev just the router (port 8402)
pnpm oracle           # dev just ORACLE
pnpm membrane         # dev just the Membrane UI
pnpm --filter @aigency/oracle seed        # bootstrap SurrealDB agent records
pnpm --filter @aigency/librarian lint     # run LIBRARIAN lint pass
```
